<!-- The title becomes this change's commit subject on main and its line in the
release notes: say what sbx does now ("Keep a stale template ..."). Each PR is
one change that can be reviewed, pass CI and be merged on its own. -->

## Problem

What was wrong or missing, and who it affects.

## Change

What sbx does now. Name the layer you changed (core, extension, recipe, docs).

## Verification

The checks you ran and the app actions you tried through the CLI or API. For
lifecycle or service changes, the acceptance checklist results. List anything
you could not test.

## Upgrading

Delete this section unless an installation must do something when it upgrades
past this change, or the API, CLI, settings or recipe format change
incompatibly. Then say what, and label the PR `breaking`.
